parts.zh: W: 关于海豚最有趣的实验之一
M: 那他具体是怎么做的呢？
W: 首先，他把两只海豚养在同一个水箱里
M: 听起来复杂得不得了
M: 哦，是的，确实受到了保护
W: 所以它会一直是公园绿地？
M: 没错。正如你所看到的
W: 我想它在春天看起来一定很漂亮

items.stem: What is the purpose of Doctor Jarvis Bastian's experiment?

choices.text: To test how responsive dolphins are to various signals.
choices.zh: 测试海豚对各种信号的反应能力。

choices.text: To see if dolphins can learn to communicate with each other.
choices.zh: 看海豚是否能学会相互交流。

choices.text: To examine how long it takes dolphins to acquire a skill.
choices.zh: 检验海豚掌握一项技能需要多长时间。

choices.text: To find out if the female dolphin is cleverer than the male one.
choices.zh: 查明雌海豚是否比雄海豚更聪明。

items.stem: What were the dolphins supposed to do when they saw the steady light?

choices.text: Raise their heads above the water.
choices.zh: 将头部抬出水面。

choices.text: Swim straight into the same tank.
choices.zh: 径直游入同一个水池。

choices.text: Press the right-hand lever first.
choices.zh: 先按右手边的操纵杆。

choices.text: Produce the appropriate sound.
choices.zh: 发出相应的声音。

items.stem: How did the second stage of the experiment differ from the first stage?

choices.text: Raise their heads above the water.
choices.zh: 将头部抬出水面。

choices.text: Swim straight into the same tank.
choices.zh: 径直游入同一个水池。

choices.text: Press the right-hand lever first.
choices.zh: 先按右手边的操纵杆。

choices.text: Produce the appropriate sound.
choices.zh: 发出相应的声音。

items.stem: What can we learn from the experiment?

choices.text: Both the dolphins did a perfect job and were rewarded with fish.
choices.zh: 两只海豚都出色地完成了任务并得到了鱼作为奖励。

choices.text: The male dolphin failed to press the levers in the correct order.
choices.zh: 雄海豚未能按正确顺序按压操纵杆。

choices.text: The female dolphin made a mistake when communicating with the male dolphin.
choices.zh: 雌海豚在与雄海豚交流时犯了一个错误。

choices.text: Dr. Bastian was surprised to see the dolphins weren't as smart as expected.
choices.zh: Bastian博士惊讶地发现海豚并不像预期的那样聪明。

items.stem: Where does this conversation most probably take place?

choices.text: In a resort town.
choices.zh: 在一个度假小镇。

choices.text: In a lecture room.
choices.zh: 在一间讲堂里。

choices.text: On a cattle farm.
choices.zh: 在一个养牛场上。

choices.text: In a botanical garden.
choices.zh: 在一个植物园里。

items.stem: What do we learn about modern Harrogate?

choices.text: It is an ideal place for people to retire to.
choices.zh: 它是人们退休养老的理想之地。

choices.text: It has kept many traditions from Victorian times.
choices.zh: 它保留了许多维多利亚时代的传统。

choices.text: It is at the centre of the fashion industry.
choices.zh: 它是时尚产业的中心。

choices.text: It remains very attractive with its mineral waters.
choices.zh: 它因其矿泉水而依然非常吸引人。

items.stem: What does the man say about the area called the Stray?

choices.text: It is located in the eastern part of Harrogate.
choices.zh: 它位于Harrogate的东部。

choices.text: It will be used as a centre for athletic training.
choices.zh: 它将被用作运动训练中心。

choices.text: It was named after a land owner in the old days.
choices.zh: 它是以旧时一位土地所有者的名字命名的。

choices.text: It is protected as parkland by a special law.
choices.zh: 它作为园地受到一项特别法律的保护。

items.stem: What attracts people most in the Stray during the spring time?

choices.text: The beautiful flowers.
choices.zh: 美丽的花朵。

choices.text: The vast grassland.
choices.zh: 广阔的草地。

choices.text: The refreshing air.
choices.zh: 清新的空气。

choices.text: The mineral waters.
choices.zh: 矿泉水。

items.stem: What do we know about Russell Fazio?

choices.text: He provides counseling for university students.
choices.zh: 他为大学生提供咨询服务。

choices.text: He teaches psychology at Ohio State University.
choices.zh: 他在俄亥俄州立大学教授心理学。

choices.text: He specializes in interpersonal relationships.
choices.zh: 他专门研究人际关系。

choices.text: He has experience tutoring black students.
choices.zh: 他有辅导黑人学生的经验。

items.stem: Who benefited from living with a white roommate according to Fazio's study?

choices.text: Students who scored low on standardized tests.
choices.zh: 在标准化测试中得分较低的学生。

choices.text: Students who are accustomed to living in dorms.
choices.zh: 习惯住宿舍的学生。

choices.text: Black students from families with low incomes.
choices.zh: 来自低收入家庭的黑人学生。

choices.text: Black freshmen with high standardized test scores.
choices.zh: 标准化测试成绩高的黑人新生。

items.stem: What did the study find about randomly assigned interracial roommates at Ohio State University?

choices.text: They generally spent more time together than white pairs.
choices.zh: 他们在一起度过的时间通常比白人配对更多。

choices.text: They moved out of the college dorms at the end of the semester.
choices.zh: 他们在学期末搬出了大学宿舍。

choices.text: They were more appreciative of the university's housing policy.
choices.zh: 他们对大学住房政策更加赞赏。

choices.text: They broke up more often than same-race roommates.
choices.zh: 他们分开的频率高于同种族室友。

items.stem: What did Dr. Fazio find interesting about interracial roommates who had lived together for 10 weeks?

choices.text: Their test scores rose gradually.
choices.zh: 他们的测试成绩逐渐提高。

choices.text: They started doing similar activities.
choices.zh: 他们开始做类似的活动。

choices.text: They grew bored of each other.
choices.zh: 他们对彼此感到厌倦。

choices.text: Their racial attitudes improved.
choices.zh: 他们的种族态度得到改善。

items.stem: What does Dr. Mironov think of bioengineering cultured meat?

choices.text: It can help solve global food crises.
choices.zh: 它可以帮助解决全球粮食危机。

choices.text: It will change the concept of food.
choices.zh: 它将改变人们对食物的概念。

choices.text: It has attracted worldwide attention.
choices.zh: 它已引起全球关注。

choices.text: It will become popular gradually.
choices.zh: 它将逐渐流行起来。

items.stem: What does Dr. Mironov say about the funding for their research?

choices.text: It will become popular gradually.
choices.zh: 它将逐渐流行起来。

choices.text: It comes regularly from its donors.
choices.zh: 它定期来自捐赠者。

choices.text: It has been increased over the years.
choices.zh: 这些年来它已有所增加。

choices.text: It is still far from being sufficient.
choices.zh: 它仍远远不够充足。

items.stem: What does Nicholas Genovese say about a lot of products we eat today?

choices.text: They are not as natural as we believed.
choices.zh: 它们并不像我们认为的那样天然。

choices.text: They are less healthy than we expected.
choices.zh: 它们不如我们预期的健康。

choices.text: They are more nutritious and delicious.
choices.zh: 它们更有营养且更美味。

choices.text: They are not as expensive as before.
choices.zh: 它们不像以前那么贵了。

items.stem: What may add to the cause of stress according to the lecture?

choices.text: Exhausting jobs and wasted time.
choices.zh: 令人筋疲力尽的工作和浪费的时间。

choices.text: Wrong eating habits and wasted time.
choices.zh: 错误的饮食习惯和浪费的时间。

choices.text: Pollution and cognitive decline.
choices.zh: 污染和认知能力下降。

choices.text: Exhausting jobs and wrong eating habits.
choices.zh: 令人筋疲力尽的工作和错误的饮食习惯。

items.stem: What can act as a healing therapy to cure personality issues?

choices.text: Adequate sleep.
choices.zh: 充足的睡眠。

choices.text: Laugh or smile.
choices.zh: 大笑或微笑。

choices.text: Music.
choices.zh: 音乐。

choices.text: Exercise.
choices.zh: 锻炼。

items.stem: What can be the reason for a massage lover to be more obsessed with it according to the lecture?

choices.text: Massage helps to improve physical function and reduce stress.
choices.zh: 按摩有助于改善身体机能和减轻压力。

choices.text: Massage plays a role in mood-boosting and is good for sleep.
choices.zh: 按摩在提升情绪方面发挥作用,并且有助于睡眠。

choices.text: Essential oils used in massage help to eliminate various diseases.
choices.zh: 按摩中使用的精油有助于消除各种疾病。

choices.text: Essential oils used in massage do good to your memory and thinking.
choices.zh: 按摩中使用的精油对记忆力和思维能力有益。

items.stem: What does the talk say about political parties before the introduction of television?

choices.text: They spent more money in promoting their political candidates.
choices.zh: 它们在推广政治候选人方面花费了更多资金。

choices.text: They attracted more members and focused on candidates' characters.
choices.zh: 它们吸引了更多成员并关注候选人的品格。

choices.text: They had more influence over the selection of political candidates.
choices.zh: 它们对政治候选人的遴选拥有更大影响力。

choices.text: They received more money from sponsors as campaign funds.
choices.zh: 它们从赞助商那里获得了更多资金作为竞选经费。

items.stem: Why was traditional political discourse more successful than televised speeches?

choices.text: It made politics seem more intimate to citizens.
choices.zh: 它使政治对公民而言显得更加亲近。

choices.text: It provided detailed information about a candidate's behaviour.
choices.zh: 它提供了关于候选人行为的详细信息。

choices.text: It allowed news coverage of political candidates.
choices.zh: 它允许对政治候选人进行新闻报道。

choices.text: It placed political issues within a historical context.
choices.zh: 它将政治议题置于历史语境之中。

items.stem: What does the speaker mean by stating "politicians assert but do not argue"?

choices.text: Politicians dislike explaining their own positions on specific issues to citizens.
choices.zh: 政治家不喜欢向公民解释自己在具体议题上的立场。

choices.text: Politicians make claims without providing arguments for the claims.
choices.zh: 政治家提出主张却不为这些主张提供论据。

choices.text: Politicians enjoy explaining issues and arguing with competitors.
choices.zh: 政治家喜欢解释议题并与竞争对手辩论。

choices.text: Politicians take stronger positions on political issues than in the past.
choices.zh: 政治家在政治议题上采取比过去更强硬的立场。

items.stem: Why do politicians create staged political events?

choices.text: They can obtain more television coverage for themselves.
choices.zh: 他们可以为自己获得更多电视报道。

choices.text: They can create more time to discuss political issues.
choices.zh: 他们可以创造更多时间来讨论政治议题。

choices.text: They can spend more time talking to citizens in person.
choices.zh: 他们可以花更多时间亲自与公民交谈。

choices.text: They can engage in debates with their opponents.
choices.zh: 他们可以与对手进行辩论。

items.stem: What's the main disadvantage of person-on-the-street interviews?

choices.text: They are not based on a representative sampling.
choices.zh: 它们不基于代表性抽样。

choices.text: They are used only on television broadcasting.
choices.zh: 它们仅用于电视广播。

choices.text: They are not carefully worded and organized.
choices.zh: 它们的措辞和组织不够严谨。

choices.text: They reflect political opinions from the public.
choices.zh: 它们反映了公众的政治观点。

items.stem: What is crucial for an effective survey?

choices.text: A large number of respondents taking part in the survey.
choices.zh: 大量受访者参与调查。

choices.text: Carefully worded and understandable questions.
choices.zh: 措辞严谨且易于理解的问题。

choices.text: An interviewer's ability to understand respondents' feelings.
choices.zh: 访谈者理解受访者感受的能力。

choices.text: A sociologist who is able to interpret the results.
choices.zh: 能够解释结果的社会学家。

items.stem: What's the advantage of live interviews over questionnaires?

choices.text: Live interviews cost less money and energy.
choices.zh: 现场访谈花费更少的金钱和精力。

choices.text: Live interviews can obtain more information.
choices.zh: 现场访谈能获得更多信息。

choices.text: Live interviews are easier to carry out.
choices.zh: 现场访谈更容易实施。

choices.text: Live interviews minimize the influence of the researcher.
choices.zh: 现场访谈最大程度地减少了研究者的影响。
